SELECT d.calendar_date, r.receipts, r.units_sold, r.net_sales_before_returns, (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=107 AND f.sale_date=d.calendar_date) fact_lines, (SELECT sum(quantity) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=107 AND f.sale_date=d.calendar_date) fact_units, (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_sales_line_load f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=107 AND f.sale_date=d.calendar_date) stg_lines
FROM dim_date d LEFT JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales r ON r.business_date=d.calendar_date AND r.store_id=107
WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' ORDER BY 1

SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, sum(f.quantity) AS units_sold,
 (SELECT coalesce(sum(r.quantity_returned),0) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store rs ON rs.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product rp ON rp.product_key=r.product_key WHERE rs.store_id=107 AND rp.subcategory='Cleaning Products' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') AS units_returned_in_period
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id=107 AND p.category='Cleaning & Household' AND p.subcategory='Cleaning Products' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=5
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
